change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Small-action edit/delete buttons no longer sit at the right edge of the row
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container (line 264). `.small-action-desc` is one of its flex items and has no `flex-grow`, so it is only as wide as its content instead of the full row (755px on desktop, `desktop/topic-post.scss:730-733`). The delete/edit `<button>`s sit inside `.small-action-desc` (`components/small-action.hbs:5,8`) and still use `float: right` (line 309). They now float to the right edge of a box that has shrunk to fit the text, so on a short action like "closed 2 days ago" they show up right after the text instead of at the post's right edge. Before this change the desc was a normal block that filled the row. Fix: give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1` (with prefixes, e.g. a `flex` mixin).

findings.title: Mobile `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` was tuned for the old 4em padding and now pulls into the icon column
findings.body: `mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522` pulls `.custom-message` 40px left. That offset made up for the old `padding: 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` on `.small-action-desc`, which this line replaces with `padding: 0 1.5%`. The desc is now a flex item beside the 45px `.topic-avatar` icon (line 273), and `align-items: center` centres that icon against the whole desc, custom message included. So the -40px likely draws the custom message over the icon on mobile, most visibly when the message runs to several lines. Please check this on mobile, and drop or change the mobile offset if needed.

findings.title: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property; the legacy prefixes only take some keywords
findings.body: No browser ever shipped `-ms-align-items`: IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, which is on line 120. Also, `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` accept `start`/`end`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`. So `@include align-items(flex-start)` would quietly do nothing in those old engines. The current callers only pass `center` and `baseline`, so nothing breaks today. You could remove line 121 and either map the keywords or document that only `center`, `baseline` and `stretch` are supported.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row: logo (`.title`, order 0), extra-info (order 2), panel (order 3, `margin-left: auto`)
contracts.equivalent_path: Before: `.title` floated left and `.panel` floated right, with `.extra-info-wrapper` as a block in the remaining space
contracts.before_after: DOM order is logo, panel, extra-info (header.hbs:4,6,93-95). `order` puts extra-info between logo and panel, and `margin-left: auto` pushes the panel right. On desktop, `.extra-info-wrapper { overflow: hidden }` lets it shrink to min-width 0, so the nowrap title still gets an ellipsis. On mobile `.extra-info` is display:none. The ::before/::after from `.clearfix` become zero-size flex items, which does no harm here.
contracts.visible_effect: Logo, topic title and icon panel are vertically centred in one row; the dropdowns stay anchored to the `position: relative` panel

contracts.action: `.small-action` becomes a flex row with `align-items: center`; the desc padding changes from a 4em left pad to 1.5%
contracts.equivalent_path: Before: `.topic-avatar` floated left and `.small-action-desc` was a full-width block padded clear of it
contracts.before_after: The desc used to fill the row, so the `float: right` buttons sat at the post's right edge. Now the desc shrinks to fit its content, so the buttons land right after the text. The mobile `-40px` custom-message offset was tuned for the old padding.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit/delete buttons on small-action posts move next to the text; the mobile custom message may overlap the icon

summary: The PR switches the header and small-action rows to flexbox through new prefixed mixins. The header reflow holds up: the `order` values and `margin-left: auto` reproduce the old float layout. One real problem is in the small-action change: `.small-action-desc` is now a flex item with no `flex-grow`, so it shrinks to fit its text, and the right-floated edit/delete buttons inside it move from the post's right edge to just after the text. There is also a likely mobile overlap, because a `-40px` offset was tuned for the old padding. The new align-items mixin also includes a property that doesn't exist (`-ms-align-items`). The badges change only adds prefixes to the existing inline-flex rule.
